   14: ## 0. Summary and substrate framing
   15: 
   16: For the phonon-exflation framework, D_K is the Dirac operator on the Jensen-deformed
   17: spectral triple over M_4 × G, where G is a compact simple Lie group acting as the
   18: internal-fiber gauge structure. The Peter-Weyl decomposition assigns every fiber
   19: excitation a Cartan-Weyl label (highest weight Λ), and the spectral moments
   20: a_k of D_K (Seeley-DeWitt coefficients in heat-kernel form) reduce to lattice
   21: sums over dominant weights with multiplicities (dim V_Λ)² and Casimir eigenvalues
   22: λ_Λ² weighted by a regulator f.
   23: 
   24: The dimensionless ratio R_1(G; L) := a_0(L) · a_4(L) / a_2(L)², with L the cutoff
   25: on Σ Dynkin-label coordinates, is a substrate spectral fingerprint. Its drift
   26: toward the L → ∞ limit defines an exponent α(R_1, G, f) by the Tauberian relation
   27: |R_1(L) − R_1(∞)| ~ C(G,f) · L^{−α}.
   28: 
   29: **Theorem (rank-universality).** For every compact simple Lie group G of rank r and
   30: every CC96-admissible regulator f, the drift exponent satisfies α(R_1, G, f) = r.
